review:
A war-god game built around Wrath Reels. When a Wrath scatter lands it expands into a wild reel with a 2x to 300x multiplier and throws up to five extra wilds onto random spots. Several Wrath Reels in one win add their multipliers together.

Only one Wrath symbol can land per reel, so two or three lining up is the realistic dream. The Fear and Flame bonus guarantees at least one Wrath Reel on every spin. 15,000x max.
